name: Elf All Stars Datsui Jan
original_name: エルフオールスターズ脱衣雀
source:
This is a strip mahjong game with characters from four Elf games (3 girls from each game) and 10 girls from Jan Jaka Jan. You have to defeat each game's male protectors in order to play with that game's girls.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
这是一款脱衣麻将游戏，角色来自四个精灵游戏（每个游戏3个女孩）和来自Jan Jaka Jan的10个女孩。你必须击败每个游戏的男性保护者才能与该游戏的女孩一起玩。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]李的欢乐屋[/url]]
